items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：An online petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia has drawn more than 160,000 signatures, as prominent tech executives, employees and shareholders rally behind the chipmaker's co-founder following his resignation last week.；The "Stand with Jensen" campaign has attracted support from Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, according to the petition's website, which notes that affiliations are self-reported and not verified.；Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993 and helped turn it into a dominant supplier of artificial intelligence chips, resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member last week following reports of extramarital affairs — including one involving a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence.
important_points: An online petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia has drawn more than 160,000 signatures, as prominent tech executives, employees and shareholders rally behind the chipmaker's co-founder following his resignation last week.

The "Stand with Jensen" campaign has attracted support from Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, according to the petition's website, which notes that affiliations are self-reported and not verified.

Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993 and helped turn it into a dominant supplier of artificial intelligence chips, resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member last week following reports of extramarital affairs — including one involving a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence.

items.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite

items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Japan's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter, shrinking at an annualized 0.1% compared to the previous quarter, as elevated energy prices weighed on consumption and net exports.；A Reuters poll of economists had estimated the economy to grow at 0.3% in the three months to September, while GDP had expanded at 1.4% in the previous quarter.；Japan's exports beat expectations for two of the three months in the quarter, but net exports weighed on the economy due to higher costs of energy imports, cutting 0.6 percentage point from the country's growth.

items.title: I'm a psychologist who studies couples—5 signs you've fallen into a common rut: 'It builds through small habits that each look harmless'

items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Couples today, especially ones who've been together for many years, are vulnerable to a silent, almost invisible and slow-growing "relationship disease." I call this condition coexistence without contact.；Couples living with this "disease" share a home, a bed and a schedule while living in almost entirely separate daily realities.；In her book "Reclaiming Conversation," for example, MIT sociologist Sherry Turkle describes the modern experience of "being together, but also being elsewhere," and argues that it undermines our capacity to have the conversations that count.
important_points: Couples today, especially ones who've been together for many years, are vulnerable to a silent, almost invisible and slow-growing "relationship disease." I call this condition coexistence without contact.
